programme.title: Titoo

programme.title: Titoo
programme.desc: Shera and his friend clash against Titoo and his brother in a paper plane battle. Later, the society's secretary loses his memory.

programme.title: Titoo

programme.title: Titoo

programme.title: Titoo
programme.desc: Titoo and Golu's search for the perfect Father's Day gift leads them to a diary containing three wishes that would make the ideal present for their old man.

programme.title: Titoo

programme.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Josh Lambert and his family relocate to his mother's old house in the hopes of recovering from past trauma. However, they soon encounter strange and chilling paranormal events.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A dying curator of the Louvre hides cryptic clues on Da Vinci paintings. Now it is up to Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu to follow the clues and unearth a secret kept hidden for centuries.

programme.title: The Walk
programme.desc: Philippe Petit, a French street performer, dreams of performing daring stunts. He attempts to walk between the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in New York on a tightrope.

programme.title: Never Back Down: No Surrender
programme.desc: Former martial arts titleholder prepares to return to familiar fields and uses his traditional fighting skills against the new line of fighters in order to reclaim his position.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Count Dracula is overjoyed to witness the birth of his grandson, Dennis. However, when Dennis shows no signs of being a vampire, Dracula tries to help him unlock his powers.

programme.title: Monster Hunter
programme.desc: Captain Artemis and her group of soldiers are pulled into a world where dangerous monsters and humans co-exist. Grappled by danger, they must find a way to escape with help from a mysterious hunter.

programme.title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
programme.desc: Ben and Zoey find themselves trapped in a series of deadly escape rooms with four others. They try to survive and find a way out as they slowly discover that they have played the game before.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker tries to stop the Vulture from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie, a wealthy mystery figure, tasks three capable and captivating women with the job of finding Eric Knox, a genius in software development and the leader of Knox Enterprises.

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter
programme.desc: Prepped to be the successor of his father's drug empire, a near-death experience alters Sergei's physicality. Sergei now treads the path of vengeance as he hunts criminals.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: A group of friends find themselves running for their very lives from Ray Sawyer, a reanimated corpse possessed by 13 evil souls, who has vicious plans for them.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: The Spengler family must join forces with the original Ghostbusters to stop an ancient evil force from refreezing the world, whilst protecting their iconic New York City firehouse headquarters.

programme.title: XXX: State of the Union
programme.desc: Darius Stone, a former US Navy SEAL, is recruited as a new agent in the XXX program to stop a rogue military faction from overthrowing the US government.

programme.title: Sound of Metal
programme.desc: Ruben, a drummer, is distraught when he begins losing his hearing. However, things take a turn when he meets Joe, who heads a community comprising people with hearing impairment.

programme.title: Sardar Udham
programme.desc: Indian revolutionary Udham Singh seeks revenge on Michael O'Dwyer, Punjab's lieutenant governor, after his troops mercilessly kill hundreds of people in the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

programme.title: 2 Guns
programme.desc: Two undercover agents, Robert and Michael, aim to expose Manny 'Papi' Greco, a drug lord. Unaware of each other's true identities, the two get into trouble when they finally meet Papi.

programme.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programme.desc: Tintin's new model ship sparks an adventure of intrigue and theft. He uncovers a historical mystery involving treasure, rival groups and a quest for scrolls revealing a sunken ship's location.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: After Spencer goes missing, his team of confidantes comes back to Jumanji to go to the undiscovered regions and support him in escaping the world's most lethal game.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: Peter Parker, the beloved superhero Spider-Man, faces four destructive elemental monsters while on holiday in Europe. Soon, he receives help from Mysterio, a fellow hero with mysterious origins.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: A hard-living superhero who has fallen out of favor with the public enters into a questionable relationship with the wife of the public relations professional who's trying to repair his image.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: A father-son duo crash-land on Earth, a millennium after an accident forced humans to evacuate the planet. With the father grievously injured, the son must put his life on the line to secure help.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: The fallout of a military nuclear test causes an iguana to mutate into a giant monster. Now this monster lays waste to cannery ships and New York City in order to feed and protect its brood.

programme.title: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: A group of co-workers embark on a team-building exercise on an uninhabited island. However, when their ex-marine guide is killed, they are left stranded and must struggle to survive.

programme.title: Sisu
